info.name: Blood Donation & Emergency Assistance Platform API
info.description: B7A6 backend assignment — Node.js/TypeScript/Express/Prisma/PostgreSQL REST API. Run requests top-to-bottom within a folder: Register/Login first to populate token variables, then Create Blood Request → Verify (admin) → Respond to Match (donor) → Schedule Donation → Complete Donation.

request.description: Login using the seeded demo admin credentials.
First-time sign-up requires role=DONOR|HOSPITAL. Existing accounts log in regardless of role sent.
Uses the httpOnly refreshToken cookie automatically set by login/register.
Call this with a DONOR token to demonstrate a 403 Forbidden from the role middleware.
Works for any role — basic account fields only.
Approves the hospital. Try isVerified=false with a remarks string to see the rejection path.
Hospital must be admin-verified first (see Verify Hospital).
Approving runs the donor-matching engine (compatibility + eligibility + location radius) in the same transaction.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const arr = pm.response.json().data; if (arr.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('matchId', arr[0].id); }
